Create Call. Creates a new call
When transcript is given, Avoma uses it instead of transcribing the recording and generates notes from it; the recording is still downloaded for playback.

additional_details.description: Additional details of the call. This should be a JSON object.

answered.description: Whether the call was answered, e.g true, false

direction.description: Direction of the call, e.g. Inbound, Outbound

external_id.description: Unique id of the call from the dialer system like hubspot, twilio, zoom, etc.

frm.description: Phone number from which call was made.

frm_name.description: Name of the caller who made the call.

is_voicemail.description: Indicates if the call is a voicemail.

participants.description: List of participants in the call. First entry should be of the prospect or lead with whom the call happened. This will be used in formulating the subject of the call in Avoma.

crm_obj_id.description: Unique identifier for the CRM object

recording_url.description: URL of the recording of the call. This will be used to download the recording by avoma for processing, so should be a public URL.

source.description: Lowercase string indicating the source of the call, e.g. zoom, zoomphone, twilio, phoneburner, ringcentral, aircall, etc.

to.description: Phone number to which call was made.

to_name.description: Name of the person to whom call was made.

language.description: Language code of the transcript. Must be one of the language codes Avoma transcription supports (for example en, es, fr, de, pt, ja); other values return 400. Regional English codes (en-US, en-GB, ...) are stored as en.

items.description: A person who speaks in the transcript. Give an email, a name, or both.

id.description: Your own label for the speaker, unique within speakers. Phrases refer to it.

email.description: The speaker's email. Links the speaker to a person and adds them as a meeting participant.

items.description: One continuous stretch of speech by one speaker.

speaker_id.description: The id of a speaker in speakers.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the recording when the phrase starts.

end.description: Seconds from the start of the recording when the phrase ends. Not before start.

transcript.description: Optional transcript of the call with speakers. When given, Avoma stores it instead of transcribing the recording, then generates notes from it. The user in user_email must have the recording feature and recording minutes left; otherwise the request fails with 403. Not supported when source is platform. Send the request as JSON to include a transcript.

actions.name: list_snippets
actions.description:
List Meeting Snippets. Returns snippets (highlights) for meetings. Snippets are AI-generated or user-created highlights from meeting recordings with timestamps, titles, and descriptions.

**Query Modes:**
- **Single Meeting Query**: Provide `meeting_uuid` to get all snippets for a specific meeting. Date filters are optional.
- **Organization-wide Query**: Omit `meeting_uuid` to get snippets across all meetings. Requires `from_date` and `to_date` (max 180-day range).

meeting_uuid.description: The meeting's uuid; list_meetings gives it

from_date.description: To retrieve snippets for meetings started at or after given date-time(UTC). **Required when `meeting_uuid` is not provided**. When querying without `meeting_uuid`, the date range cannot exceed 180 days. Must be provided together with `to_date`.

to_date.description: To retrieve snippets for meetings started at or before given date-time(UTC). **Required when `meeting_uuid` is not provided**. When querying without `meeting_uuid`, the date range cannot exceed 180 days. Must be provided together with `from_date`.

is_ai_generated.description:
Filter snippets by source:
- `true`: Get only AI-generated snippets.
- `false`: Get only user-created snippets.
- Omit to get all snippets regardless of source.

page_size.description: Number of records returned per response.

actions.name: list_webhooks
actions.description: List Webhook Subscriptions. Returns all active webhook subscriptions for the organization.

actions.name: create_webhook
actions.description:
Create Webhook Subscription. Subscribe to an Avoma event. When the event fires, Avoma will POST the event payload to your `target_url` over HTTPS.

**Supported `event_type` values**

**`target_type: 2` — Organization webhooks**

| `event_type` | Fires when |
|---|---|
| `AINOTE` | AI notes are ready for a meeting — this is the primary event for post-meeting data (transcript, notes, action items, insights). |
| `MEETING_BOOKED_VIA_SCHEDULER` | A meeting was booked through an Avoma scheduling page. |
| `MEETING_BOOKED_VIA_SCHEDULER_CANCELED` | A scheduler-booked meeting was cancelled. |
| `MEETING_BOOKED_VIA_SCHEDULER_RESCHEDULED` | A scheduler-booked meeting was rescheduled. |

**`target_t...

event_type.description: The event to subscribe to. See `POST /v1/webhooks/` for the full list and descriptions of each event type per `target_type`.

target_type.description: `2` for direct organization webhooks. `1` for Zapier-managed webhooks (requires Zapier integration feature).

target_url.description: HTTPS URL that Avoma will POST the event payload to. Must use the `https://` scheme.

teams.description: Optional list of team UUIDs. When provided, the webhook only fires for meetings whose attributed user belongs to one of these teams. Only applicable when `target_type` is `2`. Omit or pass an empty list to receive events for all meetings in the organization.

actions.name: clear_webhook_signing_secret
actions.description: Clear Webhook Signing Secret. Removes the signing secret. After this call, outbound deliveries will no longer include an `X-Avoma-Signature` header.

actions.name: get_webhook_signing_secret
actions.description: Get Webhook Signing Secret. Returns the current signing secret for your organization's webhooks. The secret is used to generate the `X-Avoma-Signature` header on outbound webhook deliveries. If no secret is configured, an empty string is returned and deliveries will not include the signature header. Shows a secret: only when the person needs it, never pasted in a chat.

actions.name: set_webhook_signing_secret
actions.description: Set Webhook Signing Secret. Set a custom signing secret for your organization's webhooks. After this call, all outbound deliveries will include an `X-Avoma-Signature` HMAC-SHA256 header computed from this secret.

signing_secret.description: HMAC signing secret used to sign outbound webhook payloads. An empty string means no secret is configured and deliveries will not include the `X-Avoma-Signature` header.

actions.name: rotate_webhook_signing_secret
actions.description: Rotate Webhook Signing Secret. Generates a new cryptographically random 64-character hex signing secret, replacing any existing one. Use this to rotate your secret without downtime — update your receiver first, then rotate.

actions.name: delete_webhook
actions.description: Delete (Deactivate) Webhook Subscription. Deactivates a webhook subscription. No further events will be delivered to the associated `target_url`. The subscription is soft-deleted (`is_active` set to `false`) — it is not permanently removed.

uuid.description: The item's uuid, from the matching list action
